sloka: एकः सत् पुरुषो लोके लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया ।यो अनुगच्चति काकुत्स्थम् रामम् परिचरन् वने ॥२-४८-८॥
transliteration: ekaḥ sat puruṣo loke lakṣmaṇaḥ saha sītayā ।yo anugaccati kākutstham rāmam paricaran vane ॥2-48-8॥

translations.english: Lakshmana is the only fortunate person in the world who has followed Rama of the Kakutstha race along with Sita to serve them.
